passages.text: Behold, the LORD lays waste the earth and leaves it in ruins. He will twist its surface and scatter its inhabitants— people and priest alike, servant and master, maid and mistress, buyer and seller, lender and borrower, creditor and debtor.
passages.sermon:
The LORD acts with power and authority.
The LORD destroys the earth.
The LORD leaves the earth in ruins.
The LORD twists the face of the earth.
The LORD scatters all who live on the earth.
Every person is affected.
The common people are affected.
The priests are affected.
Servants are affected.
Masters are affected.
Maids are affected.
Mistresses are affected.
Buyers are affected.
Sellers are affected.
Lenders are affected.
Borrowers are affected.
Creditors are affected.
Debtors are affected.
No one is spared from the LORD’s judgment.
passages.original: הִנֵּ֧ה יְהוָ֛ה בּוֹקֵ֥ק הָאָ֖רֶץ וּבֽוֹלְקָ֑הּ וְעִוָּ֣ה פָנֶ֔יהָ וְהֵפִ֖יץ יֹשְׁבֶֽיהָ׃ וְהָיָ֤ה כָעָם֙ כַּכֹּהֵ֔ן כַּעֶ֙בֶד֙ כַּֽאדֹנָ֔יו כַּשִּׁפְחָ֖ה כַּגְּבִרְתָּ֑הּ כַּקּוֹנֶה֙ כַּמּוֹכֵ֔ר כַּמַּלְוֶה֙ כַּלֹּוֶ֔ה כַּנֹּשֶׁ֕ה כַּאֲשֶׁ֖ר נֹשֶׁ֥א בֽוֹ׃

passages.text: The earth will be utterly laid waste and thoroughly plundered. For the LORD has spoken this word.
passages.sermon: The LORD has spoken this word.\r\nThe earth will be utterly laid waste.\r\nThe earth will be thoroughly plundered.
passages.original: הִבּ֧וֹק׀ תִּבּ֛וֹק הָאָ֖רֶץ וְהִבּ֣וֹז׀ תִּבּ֑וֹז כִּ֣י יְהוָ֔ה דִּבֶּ֖ר אֶת־ הַדָּבָ֥ר הַזֶּֽה׃

passages.text: The earth mourns and withers; the world languishes and fades; the exalted of the earth waste away.
passages.sermon:
The earth mourns.
The earth withers.
The world languishes.
The world fades.
The exalted people of the earth waste away.
passages.original: אָבְלָ֤ה נָֽבְלָה֙ הָאָ֔רֶץ אֻמְלְלָ֥ה נָבְלָ֖ה תֵּבֵ֑ל אֻמְלָ֖לוּ מְר֥וֹם עַם־ הָאָֽרֶץ׃

passages.text: The earth is defiled by its people; they have transgressed the laws; they have overstepped the decrees and broken the everlasting covenant.
passages.sermon:
The earth is defiled.
The people who live on the earth have caused this.
They have broken God’s laws.
They have ignored God’s decrees.
They have broken the everlasting covenant.
passages.original: וְהָאָ֥רֶץ חָנְפָ֖ה תַּ֣חַת יֹשְׁבֶ֑יהָ כִּֽי־ עָבְר֤וּ תוֹרֹת֙ חָ֣לְפוּ חֹ֔ק הֵפֵ֖רוּ בְּרִ֥ית עוֹלָֽם׃

passages.text: Therefore a curse has consumed the earth, and its inhabitants must bear the guilt; the earth’s dwellers have been burned, and only a few survive.
passages.sermon:
A curse covers the earth.
The people who live on the earth are guilty.
The people who live on the earth have been burned.
Only a few people remain alive.
passages.original: עַל־ כֵּ֗ן אָלָה֙ אָ֣כְלָה אֶ֔רֶץ וַֽיֶּאְשְׁמ֖וּ יֹ֣שְׁבֵי בָ֑הּ עַל־ כֵּ֗ן חָרוּ֙ יֹ֣שְׁבֵי אֶ֔רֶץ וְנִשְׁאַ֥ר אֱנ֖וֹשׁ מִזְעָֽר׃

passages.text: The new wine dries up, the vine withers. All the merrymakers now groan.
passages.sermon: The new wine dries up.\r\nThe vine withers.\r\nAll the people who once rejoiced now groan.
passages.original: אָבַ֥ל תִּיר֖וֹשׁ אֻמְלְלָה־ גָ֑פֶן נֶאֶנְח֖וּ כָּל־ שִׂמְחֵי־ לֵֽב׃

passages.text: The joyful tambourines have ceased; the noise of revelers has stopped; the joyful harp is silent.
passages.sermon:
God has judged the earth.
\r\nThe people on earth once celebrated.
\r\nThey played joyful tambourines.
\r\nNow the tambourines are silent.
\r\nRevelers once made loud noises.
\r\nNow their noise has stopped.
\r\nPeople once played joyful harps.
\r\nNow the harps are silent.
passages.original: שָׁבַת֙ מְשׂ֣וֹשׂ תֻּפִּ֔ים חָדַ֖ל שְׁא֣וֹן עַלִּיזִ֑ים שָׁבַ֖ת מְשׂ֥וֹשׂ כִּנּֽוֹר׃

passages.text: They no longer sing and drink wine; strong drink is bitter to those who consume it.
passages.sermon:
The people do not sing while they drink wine.
They do not drink wine with songs.
Strong drink tastes bitter to those who drink it.
People who drink strong drink find it unpleasant.
passages.original: בַּשִּׁ֖יר לֹ֣א יִשְׁתּוּ־ יָ֑יִן יֵמַ֥ר שֵׁכָ֖ר לְשֹׁתָֽיו׃

passages.text: The city of chaos is shattered; every house is closed to entry.
passages.sermon:
The city is chaotic.
The city is shattered.
No one can enter any house.
Every house is closed.
passages.original: נִשְׁבְּרָ֖ה קִרְיַת־ תֹּ֑הוּ סֻגַּ֥ר כָּל־ בַּ֖יִת מִבּֽוֹא׃

passages.text: In the streets they cry out for wine. All joy turns to gloom; rejoicing is exiled from the land.
passages.sermon:
People stand in the streets.
They cry out for wine.
All joy disappears.
Gloom covers everything.
Rejoicing leaves the land.
passages.original: צְוָחָ֥ה עַל־ הַיַּ֖יִן בַּֽחוּצ֑וֹת עָֽרְבָה֙ כָּל־ שִׂמְחָ֔ה גָּלָ֖ה מְשׂ֥וֹשׂ הָאָֽרֶץ׃

passages.text: The city is left in ruins; its gate is reduced to rubble.
passages.sermon:
The city stands empty.
Desolation fills the city.
Only ruins remain in the city.
People see the city gate destroyed.
The gate lies broken and in pieces.
No one can enter through the gate.
The city is now a place of devastation.
passages.original: נִשְׁאַ֥ר בָּעִ֖יר שַׁמָּ֑ה וּשְׁאִיָּ֖ה יֻכַּת־ שָֽׁעַר׃

passages.text: So will it be on the earth and among the nations, like a harvested olive tree, like a gleaning after a grape harvest.
passages.sermon:
God judges the earth.
God judges all the nations.
The land will be left bare.
The people will be few.
This is like an olive tree after harvest.
Only a few olives remain.
This is like a vineyard after the grape harvest.
Only a few grapes are left.
passages.original: כִּ֣י כֹ֥ה יִהְיֶ֛ה בְּקֶ֥רֶב הָאָ֖רֶץ בְּת֣וֹךְ הָֽעַמִּ֑ים כְּנֹ֣קֶף זַ֔יִת כְּעוֹלֵלֹ֖ת אִם־ כָּלָ֥ה בָצִֽיר׃

passages.text: They raise their voices, they shout for joy; from the west they proclaim the majesty of the LORD.
passages.sermon:
The people raise their voices.
They shout for joy.
They proclaim the majesty of the LORD.
They do this from the west.
passages.original: הֵ֛מָּה יִשְׂא֥וּ קוֹלָ֖ם יָרֹ֑נּוּ בִּגְא֣וֹן יְהוָ֔ה צָהֲל֖וּ מִיָּֽם׃

passages.text: Therefore glorify the LORD in the east. Extol the name of the LORD, the God of Israel in the islands of the sea.
passages.sermon:
The LORD is the God of Israel.
He deserves glory.
Give honor to the LORD in the east.
Praise the name of the LORD in the islands of the sea.
He is the God of Israel.
People everywhere must glorify Him.
passages.original: עַל־ כֵּ֥ן בָּאֻרִ֖ים כַּבְּד֣וּ יְהוָ֑ה בְּאִיֵּ֣י הַיָּ֔ם שֵׁ֥ם יְהוָ֖ה אֱלֹהֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃ס

passages.text: From the ends of the earth we hear singing: “Glory to the Righteous One.” But I said, “I am wasting away! I am wasting away! Woe is me.” The treacherous betray; the treacherous deal in treachery.
passages.sermon:
People live all over the earth.
We hear songs from every place on earth.
People sing, “Glory to the Righteous One.”
The Righteous One is God.
I hear these songs.
But I say, “I am wasting away.
I am wasting away.
Woe is me.”
Treacherous people betray others.
Treacherous people act with treachery.
passages.original: מִכְּנַ֨ף הָאָ֜רֶץ זְמִרֹ֤ת שָׁמַ֙עְנוּ֙ צְבִ֣י לַצַּדִּ֔יק וָאֹמַ֛ר רָזִי־ לִ֥י רָֽזִי־ לִ֖י א֣וֹי לִ֑י בֹּגְדִ֣ים בָּגָ֔דוּ וּבֶ֥גֶד בּוֹגְדִ֖ים בָּגָֽדוּ׃

passages.text: Terror and pit and snare await you, O dweller of the earth.
passages.sermon:
You live on the earth.
Terror waits for you.
A pit waits for you.
A snare waits for you.
passages.original: פַּ֥חַד וָפַ֖חַת וָפָ֑ח עָלֶ֖יךָ יוֹשֵׁ֥ב הָאָֽרֶץ׃

passages.text: Whoever flees the sound of panic will fall into the pit, and whoever climbs from the pit will be caught in the snare. For the windows of heaven are open, and the foundations of the earth are shaken.
passages.sermon:
God is the judge of all the earth.
He brings terror and judgment on the world.
Anyone who runs from the sound of fear will fall into a pit.
Anyone who climbs out of the pit will be caught in a snare.
God has opened the windows of heaven.
The foundations of the earth shake.
passages.original: וְֽ֠הָיָה הַנָּ֞ס מִקּ֤וֹל הַפַּ֙חַד֙ יִפֹּ֣ל אֶל־ הַפַּ֔חַת וְהָֽעוֹלֶה֙ מִתּ֣וֹךְ הַפַּ֔חַת יִלָּכֵ֖ד בַּפָּ֑ח כִּֽי־ אֲרֻבּ֤וֹת מִמָּרוֹם֙ נִפְתָּ֔חוּ וַֽיִּרְעֲשׁ֖וּ מ֥וֹסְדֵי אָֽרֶץ׃

passages.text: The earth is utterly broken apart, the earth is split open, the earth is shaken violently.
passages.sermon: The earth is completely broken apart.\r\nThe earth is split open.\r\nThe earth shakes with great violence.
passages.original: רֹ֥עָה הִֽתְרֹעֲעָ֖ה הָאָ֑רֶץ פּ֤וֹר הִֽתְפּוֹרְרָה֙ אֶ֔רֶץ מ֥וֹט הִֽתְמוֹטְטָ֖ה אָֽרֶץ׃

passages.text: The earth staggers like a drunkard and sways like a shack. Earth’s rebellion weighs it down, and it falls, never to rise again.
passages.sermon:
The earth is the subject.
The earth moves unsteadily.
The earth staggers like a drunk person.
The earth sways like a shaky hut.
The earth’s sin is heavy upon it.
This weight presses the earth down.
The earth falls.
The earth will not rise again.
passages.original: נ֣וֹעַ תָּנ֤וּעַ אֶ֙רֶץ֙ כַּשִּׁכּ֔וֹר וְהִֽתְנוֹדְדָ֖ה כַּמְּלוּנָ֑ה וְכָבַ֤ד עָלֶ֙יהָ֙ פִּשְׁעָ֔הּ וְנָפְלָ֖ה וְלֹא־ תֹסִ֥יף קֽוּם׃ס

passages.text: In that day the LORD will punish the host of heaven above and the kings of the earth below.
passages.sermon:
The LORD is the God of Israel.
The LORD is powerful and just.
On that day, the LORD will act.
The LORD will punish the armies in heaven above.
The LORD will punish the kings on the earth below.
passages.original: וְהָיָה֙ בַּיּ֣וֹם הַה֔וּא יִפְקֹ֧ד יְהוָ֛ה עַל־ צְבָ֥א הַמָּר֖וֹם בַּמָּר֑וֹם וְעַל־ מַלְכֵ֥י הָאֲדָמָ֖ה עַל־ הָאֲדָמָֽה׃

passages.text: They will be gathered together like prisoners in a pit. They will be confined to a dungeon and punished after many days.
passages.sermon:
God will gather these people together.
He will gather them like prisoners in a pit.
He will confine them in a dungeon.
They will stay there for many days.
After many days, God will punish them.
passages.original: וְאֻסְּפ֨וּ אֲסֵפָ֤ה אַסִּיר֙ עַל־ בּ֔וֹר וְסֻגְּר֖וּ עַל־ מַסְגֵּ֑ר וּמֵרֹ֥ב יָמִ֖ים יִפָּקֵֽדוּ׃

passages.text: The moon will be confounded and the sun will be ashamed; for the LORD of Hosts will reign on Mount Zion and in Jerusalem, and before His elders with great glory.
passages.sermon:
The LORD of Hosts is God.
He will reign on Mount Zion.
He will reign in Jerusalem.
He will show great glory before His elders.
The moon will be confounded.
The sun will be ashamed.
This will happen because the LORD of Hosts will rule with glory.
passages.original: וְחָֽפְרָה֙ הַלְּבָנָ֔ה וּבוֹשָׁ֖ה הַֽחַמָּ֑ה כִּֽי־ מָלַ֞ךְ יְהוָ֣ה צְבָא֗וֹת בְּהַ֤ר צִיּוֹן֙ וּבִיר֣וּשָׁלִַ֔ם וְנֶ֥גֶד זְקֵנָ֖יו כָּבֽוֹד׃פ
